title: Donation
description: Donation button to Parkinson's and MSA
body:
This is a FabricMC mod that adds a donation button to the home screen, next to the language button. It is fully disableable in config, and is built into all of my mods. The donate screen leads to Parkinson's UK and the MSA research donation pages.

Recently, my grandfather was diagnosed with MSA and Parkinson's diseases. These are two neurodegenerative diseases that currently have no cure.

If you would like to donate, click one of the buttons below, and then send e.everest a DM on Discord with whatever you want me to tell him. Ideally, you could also send how much was donated so we can tell him how much we have donated.

If you would like to send him a message, just DM me; you don't need to donate.
Thank you!
